desc.zh: 為關鍵基礎設施、科技園區、資料中心與能源設施建立數位孿生，整合感測、爆炸模擬與損傷評估，支援戰災與意外爆炸情境的預防、監測與方案比較。
desc.en: Digital twins of critical infrastructure, science parks, data centers and energy facilities that combine sensing, blast simulation and damage assessment to prevent, monitor and compare responses to wartime and accidental explosions.

tags: Digital twin · scenario engine · decision support

desc.zh: 以人體有限元素模型分析爆震波下的顱內壓與腦組織應變，評估爆炸性腦損傷風險；並研究衝擊式噪音對聽力的影響與頭盔等個人防護效能。
desc.en: Finite-element human body models to analyse intracranial pressure and brain tissue strain under blast, assess blast-induced brain injury risk, and study impulse-noise effects on hearing and the performance of helmets and other personal protection.

desc.zh: 以 LS-DYNA、ExDAM 與 blastFoam 重現廠區、儲能與危險物設施的爆炸情境，計算超壓分布、安全距離與人員傷害範圍。
desc.en: LS-DYNA, ExDAM and blastFoam models of explosions at plants, battery storage and hazardous-material sites, giving overpressure maps, safety distances and injury ranges.

title.zh: 抗爆結構與先進防護材料

desc.zh: 掩體、隧道、橋梁與廠房在爆炸荷載下的動態反應與補強設計；纖維混凝土、UHPC、聚脲塗層、無機聚合物與 3D 列印材料的高應變率性能。
desc.en: Dynamic response and retrofit of shelters, tunnels, bridges and plants under blast; high-strain-rate behaviour of fibre concrete, UHPC, polyurea coatings, geopolymers and 3D-printed materials.

tags: UFC 3-340-02 · P-I diagrams · high strain rate

desc.zh: 機場跑道、橋梁與關鍵設施的損傷評估、快速搶修工法，以及高早強修補材料。
desc.en: Damage assessment and rapid repair methods for runways, bridges and critical facilities, with high-early-strength repair materials.
